{{Quote|I can't beat you in an argument, Leia. I'm no politician, and the ag school in Anchorhead didn't have a debate team.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
An '''ag school''' was a type of educational institution. There was an ag school in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Luke Skywalker presumably attended the ag school there.

==Behind the scenes==
"Ag school" is a common abbreviation for "agriculture school" in the real world, and since the Humans on Tatooine were mostly [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]], it is likely that this is the case in the Star Wars universe as well, though it is not explicitly stated.
